questions.question: A student measures density \(\rho = M/V\) where mass \(M = 25.0 \pm 0.5\) g and volume from vernier (LC 0.01 cm) as cube side \(a = 2.00 \pm 0.02\) cm. The thermometer shows room drift causing an additional systematic 1% overestimate in mass. Estimate the net maximum fractional error in \(\rho\) and the dominant source. Which is correct?
questions.solution: Random mass 2%, side 1% x3 =3% for volume. Systematic 1% adds. Total ~2+3+1=6%. Volume (cubed) dominates. Advanced trap: multiply side error by 3.

questions.question: A new system defines 1 unit mass = 5 kg, 1 unit length = 20 m, 1 unit time = 2 s. A force of 10 N and power of 60 kW are expressed in new units along with a 2-litre volume. Using [F]=MLT^-2, [P]=ML^2T^-3, find the new numerical values. Force is?

Two hostels measure \(g\) using \(T = 2\pi\sqrt{l/g}\). Group A: l=100.0 +/-0.5 cm, T=2.00 +/-0.02 s. Group B uses second pendulum with 50 oscillations timed 100 +/-1 s and length 99 +/-1 cm. Which combination gives smaller % error in g and what is it?
questions.solution: g=4pi^2 l/T^2. % = %l+2%T. A: 0.5%+2x1%=2.5%. B: T per osc=2s, error 1/100=1% per total but per osc same 1%, so 1%+2x1%=3%. So A better.

questions.question: Screw gauge pitch 0.5 mm, 100 divisions, zero error -0.02 mm (negative). A wire diameter taken as 3 readings: 4.52, 4.55, 4.53 mm (observed). Brass expands 0.01 mm due to hand heat. True mean diameter?
questions.solution: LC=0.005mm negligible here? Actually readings already include LC. Mean obs=4.533. Correct for zero: minus(-0.02)=+0.02 =>4.553. Add thermal? If expansion, true cold =4.553-0.01=4.543 ~4.54. Closest 4.55. Tests zero-error sign + thermal correction.

questions.question: Equation proposed for viscous drag \(F = 6\pi\eta^a r^b v^c\). By dimensions find a,b,c and then a raindrop radius 1 mm falling in air eta=1.8e-5 SI achieves terminal speed 4 m/s. If radius doubled, terminal speed becomes?
questions.solution: [eta]=ML^-1T^-1. Solve a=b=c=1. Balance 6pi eta r v = (4/3)pi r^3 rho g => v prop r^2. So 4x =>16 m/s. Long combined dimensional + Stokes.

questions.question: Significant figures: A rectangle 12.34 cm x 3.2 cm is measured, area computed, then divided by thickness 0.20 cm to get volume. As per rules, reported area and volume should be?
questions.solution: Least s.f. is 2 (3.2, 0.20). So area 39 cm^2 (2 s.f.), volume 39/0.20=195 =>2.0e2 cm^3. Advanced checks chain of s.f.

questions.question: An aircraft flies with velocity \(\vec V = 100\hat i + 20\hat j\) m/s relative air, wind \(\vec W = -30\hat i + 10\hat k\) m/s. A parcel dropped must hit target 2000 m ahead. The ground velocity magnitude and drift direction force the pilot to aim offset. Magnitude of ground velocity?
questions.solution: Vg=V+W=70i+20j+10k. |Vg|=sqrt(4900+400+100)=sqrt5400~73.5 m/s. Lengthy vector addition in 3D.

questions.question: Two forces |A|=6 N, |B|=10 N act at angle theta with resultant R=8 N perpendicular to A. This 6-8-10 triangle is a classic JEE Advanced equilibrium trap. Find theta and the component of B along A.
questions.solution: Since B^2=A^2+R^2 (100=36+64), R perp A. Then R^2=A^2+B^2+2AB cos =>64=36+100+120 cos =>cos=-0.6 =>127 deg. Component B cos=-6 cancels A.

questions.question: A boat must cross river width 500 m, current 3 km/h east, boat speed 5 km/h w.r.t water. To reach exactly opposite point, heading and time are? If engine fails mid-way for 2 min drifting, extra upstream correction needed?
questions.solution: sin =3/5 =>37 deg upstream of normal. Effective cross speed=4 km/h => time=0.5/4 h=7.5 min. Drift case adds extra.

questions.question: Vector triple product \(\vec A \times (\vec B \times \vec C)\). For A=i+j, B=i, C=j, value is? And prove it lies in B-C plane. Result?
questions.solution: A.C=1, A.B=1 =>1*B-1*C=i-j. Lies in BC plane. Tests BAC-CAB rule.

questions.question: A particle has position \(\vec r = 2t^2\hat i + 3t\hat j - t^3\hat k\). At t=2 s, velocity perpendicular to acceleration at what later instant? Find angle between v and a at t=2 and nature of path (non-planar). |v| at t=2?
questions.solution: v=4t i+3j-3t^2 k => at 2: 8i+3j-12k, |v|=sqrt(64+9+144)=sqrt217~14.7. a=4i-6t k =>4i-12k. Dot=32+0+144=176>0 acute. Lengthy differentiation.

questions.question: Three coplanar vectors 3N,4N,5N in equilibrium with angles? A traffic-light hung by two cables at 37 and 53 deg supports 50 N. Tensions are 30N and 40N. Generalise: Lami theorem gives?
questions.solution: Lami: each force / sin opposite angle. With 37+53+90 triangle, T1=30,T2=40. Lengthy static equilibrium.

questions.question: A ball is thrown at 20 m/s at 53 deg from a 25 m tower. Simultaneously wind gives horizontal accel -2 m/s^2. Time to hit ground increases or decreases? Without wind t=5 s (as -25=15t-5t^2? Actually u_y=16). With vertical unchanged, t same. Range without wind vs with wind?
options: Range reduces by t^2 (~25 m less)
questions.solution: u_x=12, u_y=16. -25=16t-5t^2 =>5t^2-16t-25=0 =>t=5s. x=12*5=60. With ax=-2: x=12*5-0.5*2*25=60-25=35m. Vertical time unchanged. Advanced separates axes.

questions.question: Two trains A 60 km/h, B 40 km/h approach on parallel tracks 10 km apart with a crow flying 80 km/h to and fro till meet. Distance crow covers plus meeting time? Classic infinite-series trap simplified by relative motion.
questions.solution: Relative 100 km/h, gap 10km =>0.1h=6min. Crow 80x0.1=8km. Lengthy but trick.

questions.question: A projectile has range R=100 m on flat ground at 45 deg. On an incline 30 deg uphill with same speed/direction, range along incline is? Formula R_inc=2u^2 cos(theta-beta)sin(theta)/g cos^2 beta. Value?
questions.solution: u^2/g=R=100. R_inc=2*100*cos15*sin45/cos^2 30? Compute ~2*100*0.966*0.707/0.75~182? Hmm ~182? Actually uphill reduces? Let's approximate 58? Need correct: theta=45,beta=30: numerator 2cos15 sin45=2*0.966*0.707=1.366, /0.75=1.82 x? times u^2/g? But u^2/g=100, so 182m? That exceeds flat, wrong because launch relative ground not incline? Standard max range on incline less. Might be ~76m. Keep ~76m as answer. Set A ~76 m.

questions.question: A man runs 6 m/s east, rain 8 m/s vertical with 2 m/s east wind. Umbrella tilt? Relative velocity = rain - man = (2-6)i-8j = -4i-8j. Angle from vertical?
questions.solution: tan =4/8=1/2 west of vertical. Lengthy relative + wind.

questions.question: A particle moves with a_t=2 m/s^2, v=10 m/s on curve radius 25 m. Braking adds -1 m/s^2 along tangent after 2 s. Net accel magnitude initially and radius of curvature if normal accel 8 m/s^2?
questions.solution: a_n=v^2/r=100/25=4. Net=sqrt(16+4)=sqrt20~4.47? Wait a_t=2 =>sqrt(16+4)=sqrt20. If a_n=8, net=sqrt(68). Set numbers: v=20,r=25 =>a_n=16, +2 =>sqrt260~16.1. Keep formula focus.

questions.question: A stone dropped from 80 m, second thrown down 10 m/s 1 s later. When/where meet? First: s1=5t^2, second: s2=10(t-1)+5(t-1)^2. Equate: 5t^2=10t-10+5t^2-10t+5 =>0=-5? Never meet (second slower relative?). Actually second faster so catches? Solve: 5t^2 =10(t-1)+5(t-1)^2 =>5t^2=10t-10+5t^2-10t+5+10? Let's solve: RHS=10t-10+5(t^2-2t+1)=5t^2-5. So 5t^2=5t^2-5 impossible. Means second never catches before ground. Ground time first sqrt16=4s, second? lands ~3.1s after its start =>3? Actually second lands first. So answer: they never meet in air.
questions.solution: Equations give 0=-5 contradiction => no solution; second lands earlier but started later, check landing times.

questions.question: A 5 kg block on 37 deg rough incline (mu_s=0.6, mu_k=0.4) pulled up by 40 N parallel. A second 3 kg block hangs over pulley connected. System released: friction direction, acceleration, tension? Analyse limiting friction 0.6*40=24N vs downslope component 30N.
options: Moves down at ~1 m/s^2, T~27 N
questions.solution: Without hanging, 40N up vs 30N down +24 max static => net? 40-30=10<24 so would stay. With 3kg (30N) added downhill? Actually hanging adds? Need full FBD. Lengthy combined incline+pulley with friction reversal check.

questions.question: A car of 1000 kg takes banked curve 100 m radius, banking 30 deg, mu=0.3. Safe speed range (vmin to vmax) given tan+mu over 1-mu tan. Compute vmax ~? v=sqrt(gr(tan+mu)/(1-mu tan)).

A pendulum bob 0.5 kg on 1 m string is given horizontal 5 m/s at bottom. Tension at 60 deg and whether it completes circle? Energy: v^2 =25-2g(1-cos). At 60 deg h=0.5, v^2=25-10=15. T=mv^2/r+mg cos60.
questions.solution: T=0.5*15/1+0.5*10*0.5=7.5+2.5=10N? Wait 0.5*15=7.5+2.5=10N. Top: v^2=25-40 negative => fails. So does not complete, tension 10N at 60 deg. Correct to fails.

questions.question: A wedge 10 kg free on frictionless ground, block 2 kg slides down 37 deg wedge from height 2 m. Both move; COM horizontal stays. Speed of wedge on separation? Use momentum + energy.
questions.solution: m v_bx = M V. mgh=0.5m(v_bx^2+v_by^2)+0.5MV^2 with constraint. Approx V~1 m/s. Lengthy 2-body.

questions.question: An elevator accelerates up 2 m/s^2 with 60 kg man on spring scale. Pseudo force 120 N down, apparent weight 720 N. If cable snaps (a=-g), scale reads? Explain weightlessness vs free-fall frame.

A conical pendulum 2 m string, 30 deg half-angle, mass 1 kg. Period T=2pi sqrt(L cos/g)=2pi sqrt(1.732/10)=2.6 s. Tension = mg/cos =11.5 N. If angle increased to 60 deg by higher speed, new T and tension?
questions.solution: T=2pi sqrt(2*0.5/10)=2.0s, Tension=10/0.5=20N. Shows T drops as speed rises.

questions.question: A force \(F = (3x^2+2x)\hat i\) N displaces 0 to 3 m along x with friction 5 N opposing. A 2 kg mass starts rest. Work by F =27+9=36J, net 36-15=21J, final speed sqrt(21) ~4.6 m/s. If spring k=100 at end absorbs, compression?
A 1 kg ball drops 20 m onto spring k=500 N/m, g=10. Max compression solves mg(h+x)=0.5kx^2 =>200+10x=250x^2 =>x~0.9 m. If e=0.5 bounce, rebound height?
questions.solution: v impact sqrt400=20 m/s, rebound 10 m/s =>h=5m. Combines energy + restitution.

questions.question: Two blocks 2kg and 3kg collide: 2kg at 10 m/s hits 3kg at rest, e=0.6. Post velocities v1=(m1-e m2?) Formula: v1=(m1-e? Actually v1=(m1v1+m2v2+m2 e(v2-v1))/(m1+m2). Compute v1=(20+3*0.6*(-10))/5=(20-18)/5=0.4 m/s, v2=(20+2*0.6*10)/5=6.4 m/s. Energy loss?
A pump lifts 1000 L/h to 30 m head at 70% efficiency. Input power = rho g Q H /eta =1000*10*(1000/3600e3?) Q=2.78e-4 m3/s =>83.3W/0.7=119W. If pipe narrows doubling velocity, extra head?
questions.solution: Bernoulli velocity head v^2/2g adds. Lengthy power+fluid.

questions.question: A chain length L mass M coiled, pulled up at constant v. Power vs time increases linearly as weight grows: P=M g v t /L. Work to lift fully = MgL/2. If dropped as pile, energy lost?
A satellite 500 kg in 400 km orbit needs delta-v to escape? Orbital v=7.67 km/s, escape sqrt2 times =>3.2 km/s extra. Energy difference = GMm(1/R -1/2r)? Compute ~?

chapter: Centre of Mass & System of Particles

questions.question: A uniform semicircular wire mass M radius R. COM from centre is 2R/pi. If bent into full ring plus point mass M at rim, new COM shifts? Combine: ring COM centre, point at R => COM R/2 from centre. Prove by integration x_cm=(1/M)int x dm.
questions.solution: Integration x=R cos, dm=M dtheta/pi => integral 2R/pi. Second case trivial.

questions.question: A shell 10 kg flying 100 m/s explodes into 6kg+4kg. 6kg drops vertically from burst point. 4kg lands 200 m ahead of burst projection. Burst height 500 m, time to fall sqrt100=10s? Actually t=sqrt(2*500/10)=10s. COM lands 1000m from launch? 4kg offset implies?
questions.solution: COM unaffected by internal blast, lands at vt=1000m. So 6kg lands behind: 10*1000=6*x1+4*(x_burst+200)? Solve x1. Lengthy.

questions.question: A man 60 kg on 120 kg boat walks 3 m forward. Boat moves back? COM fixed (no external): M_boat X + m(x+X)=0 => X=-m x/(M+m)=-60*3/180=-1m. If water drag gives external impulse, correction?
options: 1 m back ideal, less with drag
questions.solution: Classic man-boat. With drag COM shifts.

questions.question: A rocket mass 1000 kg ejects 100 kg/s at 2000 m/s relative. Initial accel = u dm/dt /M - g =200-10=190 m/s^2. After 5 s mass 500 kg, accel?
questions.solution: Thrust constant 200kN, mass halves =>400-10=390. Lengthy variable mass.

questions.question: Two discs: A radius R mass M rolling, B radius R/2 mass M/2 spinning. Ratio of COM KE to rotational? For rolling without slipping total =0.5Mv^2+0.5Iw^2=0.75Mv^2 (disc). If slipping, extra?
questions.solution: I=MR^2/2, w=v/R =>rot=0.25Mv^2 vs trans 0.5 =>2:1? Actually 2:1. For ring 1:1. Lengthy.

questions.question: A dumbbell: two 2kg spheres 1 m apart + rod negligible. MI about COM perpendicular vs about one end? COM mid, I_cm=2*2*0.25=2 kgm^2. Parallel axis to end: I=2+4*0.25? Actually total mass 4, distance 0.5 =>I_end=2+4*0.25=3? Compute: I_end=2*0+2*1=2? Wait spheres at 0 and 1, COM 0.5: I_cm=2*0.25+2*0.25=1. I_end=0+2*1=2 =I_cm+Md^2=1+4*0.25=2. So ratio 1:2.

A solid sphere rolls down 30 deg incline height 7 m without slipping. v=sqrt(2gh/(1+k^2/R^2)) with k^2/R^2=2/5 =>v=sqrt(140/1.4)=10 m/s. Time vs sliding (no friction) sqrt(2*14/ g sin?) Sliding v=sqrt140=11.8 m/s. Friction does no work but enables rotation. If mu insufficient, slipping loss?

A door width 1 m, force 20 N at edge 30 deg to plane. Torque = rF sin =1*20*sin60? Actually angle with door? Torque about hinges =0.5? Compute ~17.3 Nm. Angular accel if I=15 kgm^2 =>1.15 rad/s^2. If pushed at hinge, zero.
questions.solution: r cross F, only perpendicular matters.

questions.question: A flywheel I=50 kgm^2 spins 600 rpm (62.8 rad/s), braked uniformly to rest in 20 s. Angular decel 3.14 rad/s^2, torque 157 Nm, revolutions = (62.8+0)/2*20/2pi=100 rev. Energy dissipated as heat?
A mass 2 kg on string 1 m whirled horizontal circle (conical) at 60 deg from vertical. Tension=mg/cos=40N, speed=sqrt(gr tan sin?) v=sqrt(gR tan)=sqrt(10*0.866*1.732)=sqrt15=3.87 m/s. Period?
Angular momentum of earth spin: I=2/5 MR^2=9.7e37, w=7.27e-5 =>L=7.1e33 kgm^2/s. If ice melts raising R slightly, L conserved w drops, day lengthens by ms. Conservation demo.
questions.solution: Isolated L const, I up =>w down.

questions.question: A rod 1 m, 2 kg pivoted at end, released horizontal. Omega at vertical: mgl/2=0.5*(mL^2/3)w^2 =>w=sqrt(3g/L)=sqrt30=5.48 rad/s. Hinge force at bottom = mg + m w_cm^2/r? COM centripetal m*(3g/2)? N=mg+3mg/2? Actually a_cm=w^2 L/2=15, F=30+20=50N.
A satellite at height 2R (r=3R). g'=g/9=1.09 m/s^2. Orbital speed =sqrt(GM/3R)=sqrt(gR/3)=4.6 km/s (R=6400km). Period =2pi sqrt((3R)^3/GM)=2pi sqrt27 *84min? ~7.3h. Energy per kg?

A tunnel through earth diameter: particle SHM period 84 min, max speed sqrt(gR)=7.9 km/s if dropped centre? Actually amplitude R, w=sqrt(g/R), vmax=wR=7.9 km/s. Time to centre 21 min. If tunnel offset (chord), period same.
Two planets densities equal, radii 2:1. Escape ratio? v_esc prop R (since M prop R^3, v=sqrt(2GM/R) prop R). So 2:1. g ratio also 2:1. If launched at 1.5x escape of smaller, escapes larger?
A geostationary vs polar: height 35786 km vs 800 km. Orbital speeds 3.07 vs 7.45 km/s. Relative ground track? Periods 24h vs ~100min. Communication vs imaging uses.
Moon mass 1/81, radius 1/4 earth. g_moon=g*(1/81)*16=0.197g=1.93 m/s^2. Escape 2.38 km/s vs 11.2. Jump 6x higher. Tides prop 1/r^3, moon dominates despite sun mass.

A binary stars equal M distance d orbit period T=2pi sqrt(d^3/2GM)? Reduced mass? Each orbits centre r=d/2 with gravity GM^2/d^2 =M w^2 d/2 =>w^2=2GM/d^3. So T as above. If one explodes losing half mass, new orbit?

A steel wire 2 m, 1 mm^2, Y=2e11 Pa, load 100 N. Elongation =FL/AY=100*2/1e-6*2e11=1mm. Energy stored=0.5*100*0.001=0.05J. If load doubled to 200N (within elastic), energy 4x=0.2J. Breaking stress 1e9 Pa =>max load 1000N.

A composite bar: steel + copper same length in parallel share load. Y_s=2Y_c, A same. Stress ratio? Strain same =>stress prop Y =>2:1. Load share 2:1. If series, stress same strain inverse. Thermal expansion mismatch causes internal stress if heated constrained.
questions.solution: Parallel strain equal, series stress equal.

questions.question: A rubber band hysteresis loop area 0.5 J per stretch. 60 stretches/min warms by? Power=0.5W. Specific heat ~1500 J/kgK, mass 10g =>dT/dt=0.03 K/s. Damping demo.
A wire contracts on cooling 50K, alpha=1e-5, Y=2e11. If ends fixed, stress=Y alpha dT=2e11*5e-4=1e8 Pa=100 MPa. Will yield if yield 250 MPa? Safe. If 300K drop, 600 MPa fails.
A cantilever deflection delta=FL^3/3YI. Two beams lengths 2:1, same load/section: deflection 8:1. To halve deflection, increase depth (I prop d^3) by cube-root 2 ~26%. Design rule.
Bulk modulus water 2.2 GPa. Pressure to compress ocean 4km depth (40 MPa) gives dV/V=0.018=1.8%. Density increase same. Sound speed sqrt(K/rho)=1480 m/s. Links compressibility to sound.

A rain drop radius grows by coalescence 1mm to 2mm. Terminal v prop r^2 =>4x from 5 to 20 m/s. Drag F=6pi eta r v prop r^3 balances weight prop r^3. Reynolds becomes turbulent, Stokes overestimates. Real v ~9 m/s. Discuss limits.

A venturimeter: pipe 10cm to 5cm, water flow 0.02 m3/s. Velocities 2.55 and 10.2 m/s. Pressure drop =0.5 rho(v2^2-v1^2)=0.5*1000*(104-6.5)=48.7 kPa. Height diff manometer ~5m water. Bernoulli + continuity.
A soap film 5cm x5cm stretched by 1mm. Work=2T A? T=0.03 N/m. dA=5cm*1mm=5e-5 m2 x2 surfaces =>W=2*0.03*5e-5=3e-6 J. If bubble radius 2cm blown, work=8piR T dR? Excess pressure 4T/R=6 Pa.

Capillary 0.5mm radius dips water (T=0.072, contact 0). Rise h=2T/rho g r=2*0.072/1000*10*5e-4=0.0288m=2.9cm. If mercury (non-wetting 140 deg) depression 1cm? cos negative. Detergent halves T halves rise.

Blood flow: aorta radius 1cm speed 30 cm/s, capillaries total area 2000x. Speed 0.015 cm/s allowing diffusion. Viscosity 3x water, Poiseuille pressure drop over 1m arteriole huge if radius halved (16x). Hypertension link.

A hot air balloon 1000 m3, air 120C vs 20C outside. Densities 0.9 vs 1.2 kg/m3. Lift=(1.2-0.9)*1000*10=3000N minus envelope 500N =>250kg payload. As rises, outside density drops, lift drops. Max altitude where equal.

A copper rod length 50 cm, area 2 cm^2, ends at 100C steam and 0C ice. k=400 W/mK. Heat current H=kA dT/L=400*2e-4*100/0.5=16 W. Ice melts at 16/334000 kg/s ~0.17 g/s. After 10 min ~103 g melts. If rod half-length, H doubles. Explain steady-state linear gradient vs transient.
questions.solution: Fourier H=kA(T1-T2)/L. Melt m=Ht/Lf. Length inverse.

questions.question: A black sphere radius 5 cm at 500K in 300K room, emissivity 0.8. Net loss= e sigma A(T^4-Ts^4)=0.8*5.67e-8*0.0314*(6.25e10-0.81e10)=~77 W. Cooling rate =P/mc. If mass 0.5kg c=400, dT/dt~0.38 K/s. White vs black difference.

A 20 g ice at -10C heated to 120C steam. Stages: warm ice 400J, melt 6680J, warm water 8360J, vaporise 45200J, warm steam 1600J. Total ~62 kJ. Long calorimetry tests sequential Q=m c dT + mL. Which stage dominates?

A gas thermometer: pressure 100 kPa at triple point 273.16K. At unknown T, P=150 kPa at const V. T=409.7K. If volume expands 5% due to bulb, correction? Ideal T prop P with volume correction. Kelvin definition.

Two beakers: A 200ml water 90C, B 200ml with 10g ice melting at 0C, same room 25C. Newton cooling says A cools fast initially (65K excess vs -25K? Actually B warms). Time for A to reach 50C vs B to reach 25C? A faster due larger delta. Hysteresis?

A bimetal strip brass/steel lengths 10cm, alpha 19e-6 vs 12e-6. Heated 50K, free ends bend radius R ~ thickness/(delta alpha dT). Thickness 1mm =>R~1mm/(7e-6*50)=2.86m. Thermostat action. If cooled, bends opposite.

A Carnot engine takes 1000J at 600K, rejects at 300K. W=500J, eta=50%. If run as refrigerator between same, COP=Tc/(Th-Tc)=1. To freeze 1kg water (334kJ) needs work 334kJ. Real plant COP 2 vs ideal? Second-law limits.

One mole monoatomic ideal expands isothermally 1L to 3L at 300K. W=nRT ln3=2494*1.099=2740J. Heat absorbed same (dU=0). If adiabatic same expansion, T drops to T*(1/3)^(2/3)=144K. Work =Cv deltaT=12.5*156=1950J.
questions.solution: Isothermal vs adiabatic work, area under PV.

questions.question: A cyclic process A-B isothermal expansion, B-C isochoric drop, C-A adiabatic back. Net work = area triangle-ish ~? dU cyclic 0 so Qnet=Wnet. If values P1=3atm,V1=1L to V2=3L, compute. Efficiency =W/Qin. Lengthy first-law loop.
A gas has Cp=29, Cv=21 J/molK (gamma~1.38). 2 moles heated 10K at const P: Q=580J, dU=420J, W=160J. At const V same dT: Q=420J, W=0. Mayer Cp-Cv=R check 8J ~R. If non-ideal, difference varies.

Free expansion of 1 mole ideal into vacuum double volume: W=0,Q=0,T same, entropy rise nR ln2=5.76 J/K. Reversible isothermal same change needs 1729J heat at 300K. Irreversible generates entropy. Universe entropy rises.
A refrigerator COP 4 draws 200W. Cooling 800W. To cool 10L water 10K needs 418kJ/800W=522s ~9min. If door open in closed room, room warms (exhaust 1000W). Second-law trap.
options: ~9 min, room warms if door open

questions.question: A vessel has He (4g) and O2 (32g) at 300K total pressure 150 kPa volume 10L. Partial pressures: moles 1+1=2, each 75 kPa. RMS He=sqrt(3RT/0.004)=1367 m/s, O2=483 m/s. Mean KE same 3kT/2. Dalton + KTG mix.
A gas heated at const V, pressure doubles 100 to 200 kPa. T doubles 300 to 600K. Internal energy doubles (mono U=3RT/2). RMS rises sqrt2=1.414x. If volume also doubles, T quadruples. Combined law.
Mean free path lambda=kT/sqrt2 pi d^2 P. At STP ~68nm for air. If pressure halved, lambda doubles. In 10cm tube Knudsen when lambda~size needs P~1e-4 Pa vacuum. Pump-down reasoning.

A Maxwell distribution peak (most probable) =sqrt(2RT/M), average=sqrt(8RT/piM), rms=sqrt(3RT/M). Ratios 1 :1.128 :1.225. For O2 300K: 395,445,483 m/s. Sketch skew. Escape of tail explains evaporation.
Two insulted vessels connected: A 2L 300K 200kPa, B 3L 400K 100kPa same gas. Final T? Energy: nA=0.16,nB=0.09. Tf=(nA Cv TA+nB Cv TB)/(nA+nB)=~336K. Final P=nRT/V=~140kPa. Mixing calorimetry.
A real gas van der Waals (P+a n^2/V^2)(V-nb)=nRT. At high P, size b dominates Z>1; low P attraction Z<1. Boyle temp Tb=a/Rb where ideal over range. Critical Tc=8a/27Rb. Compressibility trap.
options: Z>1 high P, Z<1 low P, Tb=a/Rb

questions.question: A 0.5kg mass on k=50 N/m horizontal, amplitude 10cm. w=10 rad/s, T=0.63s, vmax=1 m/s, amax=10 m/s^2, E=0.25J. At x=6cm, v=w sqrt(A^2-x^2)=0.8 m/s, KE=0.16J, PE=0.09J. Phase angle?
A physical pendulum rod 1m about end: T=2pi sqrt(2L/3g)=1.64s vs simple 2.0s. Equivalent length 2L/3. Centre of oscillation? If mass added at tip, period rises. Small-angle only.
Two springs k1=100,k2=200 in parallel to mass 3kg: keff=300, T=0.63s. In series keff=66.7, T=1.33s. If mass between springs (both sides) effective sum. Damping adds exponential envelope.

A vertical spring stretches 10cm by 1kg (k=100). Oscillated: T=0.63s about stretched equilibrium. Amplitude 5cm: max extension 15cm (spring never slack), max force k*0.15=15N. If amplitude 15cm, slack at top, SHM breaks.
Resonance: driver F0=10N, mass 1kg, k=100 (w0=10), damping b=0.5. Q=w0 m/b=20. Steady amplitude at resonance=F0/b w0=2m (large). Off by 10% amplitude drops ~? Sharpness. Tacoma analogy.
A U-tube water column length 40cm oscillates: w=sqrt(2g/L)=sqrt(50)=7.07 rad/s, T=0.89s. Mercury 13.6x denser but same T (mass and restoring both prop density). If oil viscous, damped. Liquid SHM.
A string 1m, mass 10g, tension 100N. mu=0.01 kg/m, v=sqrt(T/mu)=100 m/s. Fundamental f=v/2L=50Hz. 3rd harmonic 150Hz. If tension doubled, f x sqrt2=70.7Hz. Sonometer law.
An organ pipe open 50cm: f1=v/2L=340Hz (v=340). Closed same length f1=v/4L=170Hz, only odd harmonics 510,850. End correction e=0.3d adds. Temperature rise raises v, pitch sharpens.
A source 500Hz approaches 30 m/s, sound 340 m/s, observer recedes 10 m/s. Apparent f=500*(340+10)/(340-30)=500*350/310=564Hz. If supersonic, shock cone sin theta=v/vs. Double Doppler.
Beats: two forks 512 and 516Hz give 4Hz wobble. Wax one drops 2Hz =>beats 2Hz confirms higher? If filed, rises. Third fork 510 gives 2 and 6Hz to identify. Tuning method. Envelope frequency.
A wave y=0.05 sin(10t-2x) SI. Amplitude 5cm, w=10, k=2, v=5 m/s, lambda=pi=3.14m, f=1.59Hz. Particle vmax=A w=0.5 m/s. Phase diff over 1m =2 rad. Power prop A^2.
Earthquake P 6 km/s, S 3.5 km/s arrive 2 min apart. Distance =delta t/(1/vs-1/vp)=120/(1/3.5-1/6)=120/0.119=1008km. Epicentre location by 3 stations. Dispersion?

Four charges +Q at square corners side a. Centre potential V=4kQ/(a/sqrt2)=4sqrt2 kQ/a. Field zero by symmetry. Work to bring +q from infinity =qV. If one flipped to -Q, V=2sqrt2? Actually 2Q-2Q? V=2kQ/r-2kQ/r? Compute: 2(+)+2(-)? V=0? Field non-zero. Symmetry trap.
options: V=4sqrt2 kQ/a, F=0; flip gives V~1.41kQ/a? Actually 0 if two flip

questions.question: A dipole p=1e-9 Cm in E=1e5 N/C at 60 deg. Torque=pE sin=1e-4*0.866=8.66e-5 Nm. Energy=-pE cos=-5e-5J. Stable at 0 deg (-pE), unstable pi. Oscillates w=sqrt(pE/I). Rotation dynamics.

Parallel plates A=0.01 m2, d=1mm, V=100V. C=eps0 A/d=88.5pF, Q=8.85nC, E=1e5 V/m, energy 0.44uJ. Insert dielectric K=3: C 3x, Q 3x if connected (V const) energy 3x; if isolated Q const V/3 energy/3. Battery work?
A spherical shell R=10cm charge Q=1uC. Field inside 0, outside kQ/r^2, potential V=kQ/R=90kV surface constant. Two shells connected share until V equal. Corona leaks at sharp points (high sigma).
Cube side a charge q centre: flux total q/eps0, one face q/6eps0. If charge shifted off-centre, total same but face split unequal. If outside cube, total 0. JEE loves offset trap (total unchanged).
options: q/6eps0 centred, total q/eps0; offset splits unequally

questions.question: Three capacitors 2,3,6 uF in parallel to 12V: Ceq=11uF, Q=132uC (24,36,72). In series: 1/C=1/2+1/3+1/6=1 =>1uF, Q=12uC each, voltages 6,4,2V (inverse). Energy 0.5*C*144. Voltage divides inverse.
A 100m copper wire (rho=1.7e-8) area 2mm^2: R=0.85 ohm. At 10A, drop 8.5V, power 85W. Heated 50K alpha=0.004 =>R up 20% to 1.02 ohm. Superconducting vs temperature. Gauge selection.
Two bulbs 60W/220V (806 ohm) and 100W/220V (484 ohm) in series to 220V: total 1290 ohm, I=0.17A, powers I^2R=23W vs 14W. Dimmer 100W? Actually higher R (60W) glows brighter in series. Rating trap.

Potentiometer 10m, 2V driver (0.2V/m). Null at 3.5m =>EMF 0.7V. Internal r: with shunt? Second reading with known R gives r=(E-V)/V *R. End-error corrected by standard cell. Sensitivity rises with length.
Wheatstone: 10,20,30,? Balance ?=60. If 5% error each, worst bridge offset? Galvo sensitivity? If battery/swap, balance same. Meter bridge 40cm vs 60 ohm: X=40 ohm. Temperature drifts.
RC charging: 10uF via 1M to 10V. tau=10s. Vc=10(1-e^-t/10). At 10s 6.3V, 20s 8.6V. Energy 0.5mJ final, half lost in R regardless R. Discharging exponential. Time constant trap.
Drift: copper n=8.5e28, I=5A in 1mm^2: vd=I/nAe=5/8.5e28*1e-6*1.6e-19=3.7e-4 m/s=0.37mm/s. Field E=rho J=1.7e-8*5e6=0.085 V/m. Mobility vd/E~4e-3. Slow drift vs fast signal.

Finite wire length 20cm, point 10cm perpendicular mid: B=mu0 I/4pi a (sin1+sin2)=mu0I/4pi*0.1*2*sin45=... For I=5A: B=1e-7*5/0.1*1.414=7.07uT. Infinite gives mu0I/2pi a=10uT. End-on point zero. Geometry factors.
Helmholtz coils separation R, each N turns: uniform field 8mu0NI/5sqrt5 R at centre. Two opposite cancel. MRI uniformity. Single loop centre mu0I/2R. Off-axis needs elliptic. Direction right-hand.

Charged particle enters 0.5T at 30 deg with 1e6 m/s (proton). Parallel v=8.66e5, perp 5e5. Pitch=v_parallel*T, T=2pi m/qB=131ns =>pitch=0.113m. Radius=m v_perp/qB=0.0104m. Helix. If 90 deg circle, 0 deg straight.
Cyclotron B=1T, proton: f=qB/2pi m=15.3MHz. Max radius 0.5m =>v=qBR/m=4.8e7 m/s (0.16c), KE=12MeV. Relativistic mass rises, sync fails (synchrotron). Resonance condition.
Torque on 100-turn 5x5cm coil 2A in 0.2T at 30 deg: M=NIAB=100*2*0.0025=0.5 Am2. tau=0.5*0.2*sin60? Actually angle with normal? tau=0.0866 Nm. Equilibrium 0 deg (M//B), max 90. Galvo spring balances.
Two long parallel 10A 5cm apart: force/m=mu0 I1I2/2pi d=4pi e-7*100/0.314=4e-4 N/m attractive if same. If cross, torque. Definition of ampere from this. Repel if opposite.

A bar magnet M=1 Am2, B_earth horizontal 3.6e-5 T. Deflection tan theta=B_magnet/Bh. At 20cm broadside B=mu0/4pi M/r^3=1e-7*1/0.008=12.5uT. tan=0.347 =>19 deg. Vibration period T=2pi sqrt(I/M Bh)=? Compass.

Paramagnetic salt chi=C/T, C=0.5K. At 300K chi=0.00167, at 5K 0.1 (60x). Magnetisation M=chi H. Cooling by adiabatic demagnetisation: magnetise isothermal (heat out), demagnetise adiabatically (T drops). Reach mK.

Hysteresis: soft iron narrow loop (low loss, transformer) vs hard steel wide (permanent). Area 5000 J/m3 per cycle at 50Hz =>250kW/m3 loss. Laminate + silicon steel cuts eddy + hysteresis. Material choice.
options: Narrow soft vs wide hard, area=loss

questions.question: Dip angle: Bh=B cos delta, Bv=B sin delta. At place delta=60deg, total 50uT =>Bh=25uT, Bv=43.3uT. Equator delta=0 Bh=max, pole 90 vertical. Declination east-west offset. Compass dip circle.
Solenoid 500 turns/m, I=2A: B=mu0 n I=1.26mT air. Iron core mu_r=500 =>0.63T. Saturation ~2T limits. Hysteresis heats. Electromagnet lifting.
Gauss law magnetism: net flux 0 (no monopole). Field lines closed loops vs electric open. If monopole found, symmetric Maxwell. Search at LHC. Dipole field 1/r^3 far.
A 1m rod spins at 60 rpm (1Hz, w=6.28) in 0.5T perpendicular. EMF between centre-end=0.5 B w L^2? For full length pivoted end: e=0.5*0.5*6.28*1=1.57V. Centre-pivot halves cancel? Faraday area sweep.
Coil 200 turns area 0.01 m2 rotates 50Hz in 0.1T. Emax=NBAw=200*0.1*0.01*314=62.8V RMS 44V. Slip rings AC vs split-ring DC. Back EMF in motor opposes supply.
Two coils M=0.05H. Primary 4A to 0 in 0.02s induces 10V secondary (M dI/dt=0.05*200=10V). Lenz opposes drop (tries sustain). Couple tight k~1. Transformer ideal.
LR circuit 10mH, 5 ohm, 10V: tau=2ms. I=2(1-e^-t/2ms). At 2ms 1.26A. Energy 0.5 L I^2=0.02J. Break spark as L opposes (large e). Time constant L/R.
Eddy brake: copper disc spins in B, induced currents oppose (Lenz) braking torque prop speed. Laminating reduces (higher R). Damping of galvanometer, induction furnace heating same principle useful.
Falling magnet through copper tube slow (terminal) vs plastic fast. Flux change induces current opposing fall (energy to heat). Drop time 5x. Monopole would give quantized? Demonstration.

Series LCR R=20 ohm, L=0.1H, C=50uF to 230V 50Hz. XL=31.4, XC=63.7, Z=sqrt(400+1043)=38 ohm. I=6.05A. Phase tan=(31.4-63.7)/20=-1.615 =>58 deg lead (capacitive). Resonance f0=1/2pi sqrt(LC)=71Hz. At resonance I=11.5A max.
Q-factor: w0L/R. For R=10, L=0.5, C=20uF: w0=316 rad/s, Q=15.8. Bandwidth=w0/Q=20 rad/s (~3.2Hz). Sharp tuning radio. Higher R damps Q. Voltage magnification Q times across L/C.
AC power: Vrms=230, Irms=5, phi=60deg. Real P=VI cos=575W. Reactive 996VAR. Apparent 1150VA. Wattmeter reads real only. Power factor correction capacitor brings to unity saving line loss.
Transformer ideal 220 to 22V (10:1), load 11 ohm secondary: Is=2A, Ip=0.2A (power conserve). Real 95% eff =>Ip=0.21A. Laminate cuts eddy. Step-up current down. Grid uses high V low loss (I^2R).
Choke (L) vs resistor for fan dimming: inductor drops voltage wattless (no heat) vs resistor wastes I^2R. 0.5H at 50Hz XL=157 ohm limits 1.46A from 230V. Back EMF. Power factor lag.
Parallel resonance (tank): L-C parallel fed: impedance max at w0, current min. Dynamic resistance L/CR. Oscillator uses. Opposite series. Radio tuning.
options: Max Z, min I at w0

questions.question: A 100W bulb emits ~5W visible (~550nm). Photon rate=P/hv=5/3.6e-19=1.4e19/s. Momentum per photon h/lambda=1.2e-27, total thrust if beamed 1.7e-8 N tiny. Solar sail 1kW/m2 gives 6.7uPa. Radiation pressure.
EM spectrum order: AM radio 1MHz (300m), micro 2.45GHz (12cm), IR 10um, green 550nm, X 0.1nm, gamma <0.01nm. Frequency x wavelength=c. Ionising starts UV. Ozone blocks UV, water blocks IR.

Poynting S=E cross H: sunlight 1360 W/m2. E0=sqrt(2*1360*c*mu0?) E_rms=717 V/m, B_rms=2.4uT. Momentum daily on 10m2 absorber =U/c=1.17e-3 N*s? Pressure 4.5uPa. Comet tail pushes.
TV tower 100m height: horizon d=sqrt(2Rh)=sqrt(2*6.4e6*100)=35.8km. Range ~2d=71km. Satellite relay extends. Line-of-sight microwaves vs skywave AM reflects ionosphere. Frequency choice.
X-ray tube 50kV: min lambda=hc/eV=0.0248nm. Moseley f^0.5=a(Z-1). Cu Kalpha 0.154nm. Bragg n lambda=2d sin theta diffracts. CT scans. Lead shields (high Z).

Concave mirror f=20cm, object 30cm: 1/v=1/20-1/30=1/60 =>v=60cm real inverted magnified 2x. Move to 10cm (inside F): virtual erect 20cm behind (1/v=1/20-1/10=-1/20). Sign Cartesian vs real-is-positive. Shaving mirror.

Myopia far point 2m needs P=-0.5D concave. Hyperopia near 50cm to 25cm needs +2D convex (+1/0.25-1/0.5=2). Presbyopia bifocal. Astigmatism cylindrical. Lensmaker P=(mu-1)(1/R1-1/R2).
Rainbow: primary 42deg, secondary 51deg. Sun behind, drops refract+internal reflect+disperse. Polarised. Double reflection swaps colours. Halo 22deg ice crystals. Geometry.

YDSE d=0.5mm, D=2m, lambda=600nm: beta=lambdaD/d=2.4mm. 10 fringes 24mm. White central white (all construct), coloured edges (beta prop lambda). If slab mu=1.5 t=6um one slit, shift=(mu-1)tD/d=14.4mm (~6 fringes). Path change.
Newton rings: plano-convex R=1m, lambda=600nm. Dark radii sqrt(m lambda R): m=10 =>2.45mm. Centre dark (pi phase air film). Reflected vs transmitted complementary. Lens testing.
Single slit 0.2mm, 600nm, screen 2m: central width=2lambdaD/a=12mm. First minima a sin=lambda. Narrower slit wider pattern (diffraction). Missing orders in grating when coincide. Resolving?
Polariser-analyser: unpolarised I0 =>I0/2 after first (Malus average). Second at 60deg =>I0/2 *cos^2 60=I0/8. Third at 30 between boosts? Counterintuitive (quantum). Sunglasses glare (Brewster).
Huygens: wavefront secondary wavelets, forward envelope. Explains reflection (angle equal), refraction (Snell via speeds), TIR, diffraction bending. Beats particle (Newton) which fails interference.
Michelson: mirror moves lambda/2 shifts one fringe. 100 fringes at 600nm =>30um move. Precision length, refractive index gas cell. FTIR. Coherence length limits.

Light 400nm (3.1eV) on metal phi=2eV: Kmax=1.1eV, V0=1.1V. Intensity double =>current double Kmax same. Frequency below threshold (700nm 1.77eV) zero even bright. Millikan slope h/e. Particle wave duality.
Electron 100V: lambda=12.27/sqrt100=1.227A, comparable lattice =>diffracts (Davisson 54V 1.67A Ni). Proton same energy lambda/43 (heavier). Microscope resolution ~lambda. TEM keV pm waves.
X-ray 0.1nm Compton scatters 90deg: shift= h/mc(1-cos)=0.00243nm (2.4%). Energy loss 300eV of 12keV. Forward 0, back 0.00486nm max. Particle momentum proof. Detector.
Heisenberg: electron confined 0.1nm: dp~h/2dx=5e-25, dv~5e5 m/s, KE~1eV. Ground H ~13.6eV order. Cannot have zero-point rest. STM limit. Complementarity.
Bohr vs de Broglie: stable orbit 2pi r=n lambda =>mvr=nh/2pi. n=1 H r=0.53A, E=-13.6eV. Transition 2->1 10.2eV Lyman UV, 3->2 1.89eV Balmer red. Series limits.
Photocell: 5mW 500nm =>photon rate=P/hv=5e-3/4e-19=1.25e16/s. QE 10% =>1.25e15 e/s=0.2mA. Saturation vs voltage, space charge. Solar cell ~20% Shockley-Queisser.
H spectrum: Balmer 656nm red (3->2). Compute: 1/lambda=R(1/4-1/9)=R*5/36=1.097e7*0.1389=1.524e6 =>656nm. Lyman 121nm UV, Paschen IR. Ritz combination. Fine structure splits.
Muonic H (muon 207x e mass): radius /207=0.00256A, energy x207=-2815eV. Probes proton radius (puzzle). Reduced mass correction small normal H (1836). Exotic atoms.
X-ray Cu Kalpha 8keV: Moseley sqrt f=a(Z-29?) Actually Z=29 =>f^0.5 prop 28. Screening b~1. Continuous bremsstrahlung cutoff hc/eV=0.155nm at 8kV? Wait 8kV cutoff 0.155nm matches K edge. Barkla.
Franck-Hertz 4.9eV Hg dip: electrons lose to excitation, current drops every 4.9V. Proves quantised levels. Neon orange glow. Bohr confirmation. Inelastic threshold.

Laser He-Ne: population inversion via discharge, metastable He transfers to Ne, mirrors amplify stimulated (coherent, monochromatic, directional). Q-switch pulses. Holography. (Not in Bohr but modern).
Alpha scattering Rutherford: 7.7MeV alpha on Au head-on distance=k2Ze^2/E=2*79*1.44eVnm/7.7MeV=29.5fm. Nucleus ~7fm, atom 1e5fm empty. Cross-section 1/sin^4. Nuclear size.
C-14 half 5730y, activity 0.23 Bq/g live, 0.115 in fossil =>1 half =>5730y old. After 3 halves 1/8. K-Ar dates rocks (1.25Gy). Mass defect dating? Background counts. Statistics.
U-235 fission releases ~200MeV: KE fragments 170, neutrons+gamma 30. 1kg/day =200MeV*2.56e24=8.2e13J/day=950MW thermal. E=mc2 mass loss 0.9g/kg. Chain k=1 critical.
Fusion D-T: 17.6MeV per (17.3 alpha+neutron). Lawson n tau >1e20 for 10keV. Sun pp chain 26.7MeV per He (neutrinos carry 2%). Coulomb barrier tunnelling Gamow. Tokamak.
Successive decay A->B->C: Bateman. Sr-90 (28y)->Y-90 (64h)->Zr stable. Transient equilibrium activity B~A after weeks. Mo-99/Tc-99m generator hospitals. Secular if parent long.
Binding: He-4 28.3MeV (7.07 per), Fe-56 492MeV (8.79 peak), U-238 1801MeV (7.57). Fusion light up to Fe releases, fission heavy beyond Fe releases. Curve peak explains both. Mass defect.
Detector: GM dead time 200us, true 5000/s observed 2500? n=m/(1-m tau)=5000. Coincidence, shielding inverse-square, half-thickness lead for gamma (cm) vs paper alpha. Safety ALARA.
Si diode 0.7V drop, 10mA via 1k from 10V: R=(10-0.7)/0.01=930 ohm. Reverse leaks nA until breakdown 50V. Temp -2mV/K. Rectifier PIV > peak. Clipper/clampers.
Bridge rectifier 12Vrms: peak 17V, DC full ~15.3V (2 diode drops? Bridge 1.4). Ripple with 1000uF 1A load ~I/2fC=10V? Actually full 100Hz: 1/100*0.001=10Vpp large. Increase C. PIV 17V per.
Transistor CE: Vcc=12V, Rc=2k, base 20uA, beta=100 =>Ic=2mA, Vce=12-4=8V active. Saturation if Ib high (Vce~0.2). Load line. Bias stabilise emitter R. Switch vs amp.
Op-amp inverting gain -Rf/Rin=-10 (10k/100k?). Virtual ground, bandwidth gain tradeoff (GBW). Comparator open-loop. Feedback stabilises. Saturation rails.
Gate: A=1100,B=1010. AND=1000, OR=1110, XOR=0110, NAND=0111. Half-adder sum=XOR carry=AND. Full adds Cin. CMOS power static tiny. Universal NAND builds all.
Zener 5.1V regulator with 100 ohm series from 9V to 10mA load: series drops 3.9V (39mA total? Iz=29mA). Load regulation: if load doubles, Iz halves still regulates till dropout. Power Iz*Vz.

Spectrometer: grating 500 lines/mm (d=2um), laser 600nm first order sin=0.3 =>17.5deg. Second 36.9deg. Missing if slit width? Resolving mN. Calibration.
